content.text:
[Security audit - https://ok.example]
Score: 82/100 (B)
Findings: 1 high, 1 medium, 1 low, 1 info (4 total) - 12 passing checks

findings.title: HSTS header is missing
findings.evidence:
Affected location: https://ok.example/
The HTTPS response carried no Strict-Transport-Security header.
findings.impact: Browsers may still make a plain HTTP request first, which exposes sessions to downgrade attacks.
findings.remediation: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains on every HTTPS response.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy is not set
findings.evidence:
Affected location: https://ok.example/
No Content-Security-Policy header was observed.
findings.impact: Injected scripts can run without restriction if any page accepts untrusted input.
findings.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header that restricts script sources, starting in report-only mode.

findings.title: robots.txt discloses an administrative path
findings.impact: Disallow rules point crawlers and people at paths that may deserve extra protection.
findings.remediation: Protect the path with authentication and rate limiting; robots.txt is not an access control.

findings.title: Server header reveals the software version
findings.impact: Version disclosure helps attackers pick known exploits faster.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server to omit the version from the Server header.
